en.title: Weight Management
en.who: Guests who mark weight gain, a diet that worked then came back, snacking at night, stress eating, belly fat, or wanting to lose fat without losing muscle.
studyWhy: why exercise is not the same as health

say: I know how frustrating that is. You try so hard, the weight comes off, and then it comes right back. Or you eat well all day and the evening undoes it.
feel.tip: Say back what they marked, in their words. Then ask: "What have you tried before, and what happened after?"

say: Honestly, I've been there. [Your story in a line or two: when it was, what it felt like, what you tried that didn't work.]
felt.tip: Your own story, or someone close to you ("my mom", "a friend from work"). No story yet? "A lot of the people I talk to say exactly the same thing." Never make one up.

say: What I learned is that the scale can't tell fat from muscle. When you cut hard, a lot of what you lose is muscle, and muscle is what burns energy at rest. So you end up lighter but burning less, and what comes back is fat.
So the goal isn't eating less. It's eating enough protein to keep the muscle, and slowing the sugar down: vegetables and protein first, rice last. And night snacking usually starts at breakfast.
So this is what I'd start with.
found.tip: Two or three sentences, then go to the map. Pick the row that matches what they marked.

map: Diet works, then it comes back
Keeps the muscle, so what you lose is fat
A real breakfast stops the evening chase
Slows the sugar and keeps you full
Covers the vitamins and minerals a smaller plate misses
Slows the carbs they won't give up
Protein when the muscle needs it most
A better snack ready for 4 pm
Takes the edge off stress cravings
en.ask: The point is to lose fat and keep your muscle, so it starts with protein at breakfast. Want to start with this?
en.doctor: Weight changing fast for no clear reason, or with constant tiredness, feeling cold, strong thirst or missed periods? See a doctor first, because thyroid and hormones can do this too.

zh.title: 体重管理
zh.who: 适合在问卷里勾了体重增加、瘦了又反弹、晚上管不住嘴、一有压力就想吃、肚子瘦不下来，或者只想减脂不想掉肌肉的客人。
studyWhy: 读懂人体成分分析报告
为什么运动不等于健康

say: 我懂那种挫败感。好不容易瘦下来，没多久又回去了。或者白天吃得好好的，一到晚上就前功尽弃。
feel.tip: 用对方自己的话，把问卷上勾的说回去。然后问一句：“以前试过什么方法？后来怎么样了？”

say: 说实话，我也经历过。[你的故事，一两句就好：什么时候、什么感觉、试过什么没用。]
felt.tip: 讲你自己的，或者身边人的（“我妈妈”“我一个同事”）。还没有故事？就说：“我身边很多朋友也是这样。”千万别编。

say: 我后来学到，体重秤分不出掉的是脂肪还是肌肉。节食太狠，掉的很多是肌肉，而肌肉正是躺着不动也在烧热量的地方。结果人轻了，消耗也少了，反弹回来的是脂肪。
所以重点不是吃得更少，而是蛋白质吃够、把肌肉留住，再让糖慢下来：先吃菜和肉，最后吃饭。晚上嘴馋，问题通常出在早餐。
所以，我会先从这个开始。
found.tip: 两三句就够，然后看下面的对照表，挑跟对方勾的那一项对得上的。

map: 留住肌肉，减掉的才是脂肪
早餐吃对了，晚上就不会拼命找补
补上吃少了容易缺的维生素和矿物质
让躲不掉的那顿碳水慢下来
在肌肉最需要的时候补蛋白
下午四点手边有个好一点的选择
压力带来的嘴馋没那么难扛
zh.ask: 我们的目标是减脂、留住肌肉，所以第一步是早餐的蛋白质。要不要从这个开始？
zh.doctor: 如果体重在没什么原因的情况下变化很快，或者同时总是很累、怕冷、特别口渴、月经不规律，请先去看医生，甲状腺和激素问题也可能导致这些。
